    Summary

    Interdisciplinary engineer transitioning into patent law, with a background spanning software development, geotechnics and mechanics. Currently training as a patent attorney candidate in Stuttgart, Germany, following a decade of research and teaching in computational geomechanics at the University of Stuttgart.
